<script type="text/javascript"> 
    $(document).ready(function () {        
        var updateImage = function () {
            var targetDiv = $("#sectionHero");
            var imageURL = targetDiv.attr('data-img');
            if (window.innerWidth < 1024) {
                var extParam = imageURL.substring(imageURL.indexOf("&ext"));
                var baseUrl = imageURL.substring(0, imageURL.indexOf("?"));
                var imageUrlWithParams = baseUrl + "?width=" + window.innerWidth + extParam;
                if (targetDiv !== null) {
                    targetDiv.attr('style', 'background-image: url("' + imageUrlWithParams + '")');
                }
              }
            else {
                if (targetDiv !== null) {
                    targetDiv.attr('style', 'background-image: url("' + imageURL + '")');
                }
            }            
        }
        updateImage();
        var savedWidth = window.innerWidth;
        var resizeTimer;
        $(window).on('resize', function (e) {
            clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
            resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                if (window.innerWidth > savedWidth) {
                    updateImage();
                }
            }, 250);
        });

        var headline = $('.hero-callout h2').text();
        window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
        dataLayer.push({
            'homepage-hero': headline,
        });
    });
</script>
